mappings.statement: Published New Mexico SNAP FY2027 gross monthly income standard at 130% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines; threshold varies by household size.
mappings.threshold_basis: Published 130% FPG gross monthly standard; effective 2026-10-01 through 2027-09-30. This is one screening criterion, not a complete SNAP eligibility rule.

mappings.statement: Published New Mexico SNAP FY2027 net monthly income standard at 100% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines; threshold varies by household size.
mappings.threshold_basis: Published 100% FPG net monthly standard; effective 2026-10-01 through 2027-09-30. This mapping compares a supplied net-income fact; it does not compute deductions.

mappings.statement: The source lists a 200% FPG gross income standard for categorical eligibility.
mappings.unresolved_reason: Conditional categorical eligibility requires a validated qualifying-category fact and explicit applicability logic that are not present in this mapping. Preserve as review-only; do not treat this threshold as a general gross-income limit.

unmapped_source_scope: Income deductions and the computation of net income
Asset limits and their age/disability applicability
Categorical eligibility predicates and alternative income pathways
Residency, work, student, household-composition, and other SNAP conditions
Application periods, local policy, and agency determination
evaluation_boundary: Evaluate only the two individually mapped income screens. Return their separate cited outcomes; never roll them into an overall SNAP eligibility decision. Missing profile facts, household sizes outside the table, and unresolved source conditions remain unknown or review-only.
